# Results inputs, held-out second halves (FILL-IN: current best checkpoints, runs still training)

**FILL-IN.** Every number below comes from the best checkpoints available at the time of the run (selection_nd.json); the final runs finish later and the whole file is regenerated by `reproduce/run_all.sh`. Treat all values as placeholders.

Protocol. The models are trained on the first half (in time) of each MD trajectory and evaluated on the held-out second halves. Per run, one checkpoint: the epoch that minimises the in-training objective on the first halves, taken as clustering excess + depth excess + overlap guard (no diffusion term); nothing is selected on the second halves. 7-PIEZO uses only runs with at least 20 epochs trained; 14-PIEZO uses all runs. Evaluation: 32 free rollouts per second-half trajectory from its frame 0, run for its full length (7-PIEZO 8,316 and 5,552 frames; 14-PIEZO 8,101 and 5,676 frames), rollout seed 3000, with the depth scale of the first-half files. MD reference, floors and the "other MD trajectory" column are the second halves: the floor is one second-half trajectory scored against the other. "Full model" is the final recipe (squash module trained jointly) scored with squash on; "ablation (full model, squash off)" is the same checkpoints with the module off (squash_enabled false, squash weight 0); "backbone model" is the same two KL losses trained without the squash module; "comparison model" is the baseline recipe. "mean +/- sd" is over runs; model curves in the figures pool every rollout of every run (median, 5-95%); pooled MD curves weight the two trajectories equally.

Trajectory numbering: 7-PIEZO trajectory 1 is the 16,631-frame run (files 7piezo_R1*), trajectory 2 the 11,103-frame run (7piezo_R2*); 14-PIEZO replica 1 is piezo14_rep01, replica 2 piezo14_rep02.

κ = clustering score, the Gaussian KL on the log pair distance of the model against MD, as a share of the same KL for random placement (0 = MD, 1 = random); "mean part" and "spread part" are its signed parts (mean part > 0: model pair distances longer on average than MD; spread part > 0: wider spread of log distances); "frames 3000+" scores only rollout frames from 3,000 on.

Sources: results/rows_half.jsonl, stats_half.json, forecast_stats_half.json; figures in figures/.

## Calibration of κ on the second halves

KL(MD||random) / KL(MD||other MD trajectory) of the log pair distance, per second-half trajectory (the κ floor is its inverse). Full-trajectory values from the earlier pipeline: 5.5 for 7-PIEZO, 6.4 for 14-PIEZO. Rule, applied per trajectory: a normalized score (κ or histogram score) is read on a trajectory only when its MD floor is below 1, i.e. the other MD trajectory is closer to MD than random placement is; the largest cluster is read only where MD's value differs from random placement's by at least 0.5.

| system | trajectory | KL(MD||random) | KL(MD||other MD) | ratio | κ floor | histogram-score floor | MD largest cluster | random largest cluster | κ read | histogram score read | largest cluster read |

| 7-PIEZO | trajectory 2 | 0.2519 | 0.0641 | 3.93 | 0.254 | 0.485 | 5.88 | 2.73 | yes | yes | yes |

## Definitions (read from the code; file:line)

All distances are x,y minimum-image distances in the periodic box (membrane/fit_objective.py:49). Per-run values are computed on one run's 32 rollouts of one second-half trajectory; "mean +/- sd" is then over runs.

- κ: Gaussian KL of the model's ln pair distance (ln of max(distance, 1) in model units, every 4th frame, all pairs and rollouts pooled) from MD's, divided by the same KL for 8,000 uniform random placements (seed 0), so 0 is MD and 1 random (reproduce/heldout_lk.py:15, reproduce/heldout_lk.py:23, reproduce/heldout_lk.py:27). "Frames 3000+" uses rollout frames from 3,000 on (reproduce/roll_heldout.py:27).
- histogram score: histogram of all pair distances on 100 bins from 0 to box/sqrt(2), every 4th frame (reproduce/gr_lib.py:28; NBIN, STRIDE at reproduce/gr_lib.py:17); score = KL(MD||model) / KL(MD||random placement) of the histograms after merging bins by 1 (7-PIEZO) or 20 (14-PIEZO), the model histogram with +0.5 per bin (reproduce/gr_lib.py:33, reproduce/gr_lib.py:56, merge at reproduce/gr_lib.py:18; random: 20,000 placements, seed 0, reproduce/gr_lib.py:52). The floor is the same score of the other second-half MD trajectory (floor_second.json, read in reproduce/score_histogram.py:3).
- Depth-isolation coupling: Pearson correlation of a protein's node depth with its isolation (mean distance to the other proteins in the frame, membrane/fit_objective.py:57), pooled over all proteins, frames 1.. and 32 rollouts of one trajectory (membrane/fit_objective.py:67, applied at membrane/fit_objective.py:213). MD: the same pooled correlation over the MD frames that have depth, frame 0 excluded (membrane/fit_objective.py:162).
- Node-depth and junction-depth sd ratios: standard deviation of the model's node (resp. junction) depth over all rollout frames 1.., proteins (resp. junctions) and rollouts of one trajectory, divided by MD's standard deviation over its frames with depth, frame 0 excluded (membrane/fit_objective.py:217; MD sd at membrane/fit_objective.py:160). Depth is in the units of the depth files.
- Dynamics KL: for lags 1, 10, 100 and 1,000 frames (reproduce/heldout_lk.py:12) the Gaussian KL of MD's change in ln pair distance over the lag from the model's, at full frame rate (no striding), pooled over frames, pairs and (model) rollouts; the reported value is the mean of the four lag KLs in nats with no normalizer (reproduce/heldout_lk.py:32, reproduce/heldout_lk.py:33).
- Largest cluster: proteins are linked when their distance is at most the contact cutoff (68.93 nm in both systems: membrane/fit_objective.py:38 in model units for 7-PIEZO, the 14-PIEZO run configuration's fit_rc for 14-PIEZO); the cluster is the connected group and the value is the size of the largest per frame (membrane/fit_objective.py:82), averaged over all frames and rollouts of a trajectory (membrane/fit_objective.py:197); MD likewise over its frames (membrane/fit_objective.py:172).
- MD and random references for the largest cluster (one computation, used in every table and the forecast): MD over all frames of the second half at full frame rate; random placement over 100,000 uniform placements, seed 0 (membrane/fit_objective.py:166).
- Squash trace (reproduce/trace_squash.py:20): for each full-model run, reproduce/trace_squash.py:20 8 rollouts of 1,000 steps; start frames are 8 distinct frames drawn at random (numpy generator, seed 7) from the pooled frames of both second-half trajectories (reproduce/trace_squash.py:23); initial orientations are independent uniform on [0, 2 pi) per protein and rollout, torch seed 7 (reproduce/trace_squash.py:26). A step is closing when the displacement taken has a positive component towards the nearest neighbour at the start of the step (the module only shortens closing components and keeps their sign, so this is also the proposed step's direction), and h is the module's contraction factor (reproduce/trace_squash.py:42). "Contracted" is a closing step with h < 0.99 and its share is taken over all protein steps (8 x 1,000 x P per run), closing or not; "factor below 0.99 in any direction" is h < 0.99 over the same denominator (reproduce/trace_squash.py:47). Fig. squash (a) shows, per bin of nearest-neighbour distance over the module's own hard core (44 bins from 0.8 to 3.0, reproduce/trace_squash.py:16), the mean h over closing steps only, summing counts and sums over all runs of a system and drawing bins with more than 50 closing steps (reproduce/figures.py:370); the axis is cut at 1.4 core diameters, beyond which h = 1.
- Contact survival: with contact meaning distance at most the cutoff above, the probability that a pair in contact at frame t is still in contact at t+L, pooled over pairs and t, at full frame rate, per rollout; tables and figures show the median and 5-95% over rollouts (reproduce/figures.py:63).
- Overlap: share of pairs closer than the hard core (21.38 nm in both systems; 53.2 model units, membrane/fit_objective.py:39, for 7-PIEZO), over all pairs, all frames including frame 0 and all rollouts of a trajectory (membrane/fit_objective.py:203); the per-run value is the mean over the two trajectories. MD: the same share over all its frames (reproduce/figures.py:442).
- Calibration ratio: KL(MD||random) / KL(MD||other MD trajectory), the Gaussian KL of the ln pair distance defined for κ, every 4th frame, 8,000 random placements (seed 0), per second-half trajectory (reproduce/figures.py:287).
- Forecast: reproduce/roll_forecast.py:20: 32 rollouts per trajectory per run (ROLLS overrides), 40,000 steps, every 4th frame kept; runs per system (7-PIEZO all eight, 14-PIEZO all five final-model runs) are listed in the forecast section; windows are 2,000 frames (reproduce/forecast.py:21). Figure curves pool all runs and rollouts; the first model window is compared with MD's first 2,000 frames, the last with all MD frames.
